message.content: Yes, Li Hua did inquire about his protein powder intake and its relationship to his fitness goals, specifically asking Jennifer for her opinion on the best type of protein supplement to help him achieve his fitness objectives. This query came after he had already discussed adjusting his protein powder servings based on his daily protein intake recommendations. Prior to his conversation about protein powder usage, Jennifer advised Li Hua to consume protein powder to supplement his protein intake, suggesting a range of 1.6 to 2.2 grams of protein per kilogram of body weight. She recommended whey protein for muscle recovery and building lean mass, and suggested plant-based options like pea or rice protein as alternatives. However, she emphasized the importance of considering the protein he gets from his meals and focusing on protein powder supplementation primarily for post-workout recovery.
